bagPolicy.summary: The policy explicitly permits clutches no bigger than 4.5 × 6.5 inches, clear plastic or vinyl bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches, and one-gallon freezer bags. A prohibited-items list also mentions clutches generally, so keep a clutch within the stated small-bag exception.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Free general parking is at 65 Fairchild Street, with a free remote lot and shuttle at 115 Fairchild Street when offered for the concert. Limited premium parking at 155 Seven Farms Drive costs $25 per vehicle on arrival.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The stadium policies and parking page do not designate a rideshare pickup point.

concessions.summary: The stadium sells food and beverages inside; it prohibits glass or metal bottles, cans, coolers and other beverage containers.

accessibility.summary: Present a state disability placard or plate to the attendants for accessible parking. Access ramps are on the north and east sides of the stadium.
